mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(case when status = 5 and pay_status = 1 then amount else 0 end), 0) as turnover, coalesce(sum(case when status = 5 and pay_status = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as valid_order_count, count(*) as all_orders, (select count(*) from `user` where create_time >= #{begin} and create_time < #{end}) as new_users from orders where order_time >= #{begin} and order_time < #{end}

select coalesce(sum(case when status = 2 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as waiting_orders, coalesce(sum(case when status = 3 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as delivered_orders, coalesce(sum(case when status = 5 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as completed_orders, coalesce(sum(case when status = 6 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as cancelled_orders, count(*) as all_orders from orders where order_time >= #{begin} and order_time < #{end}
select coalesce(sum(case when status = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as sold, coalesce(sum(case when status = 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as discontinued from dish
select coalesce(sum(case when status = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as sold, coalesce(sum(case when status = 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as discontinued from setmeal
